request.style: English, male solo, somber and reverent, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, 70 BPM, ballad
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A man named Ananias stood with his wife
They sold a piece of property to the church
With Sapphira's knowledge he held back the price
Laying only a portion at the apostles' feet

[Chorus]
You have not lied to men but to God
Satan filled your heart with a deadly lie
The money was yours before the sale was made
Why contrive this thing in your heart so deep

[Verse]
Peter spoke the truth with a Spirit's eye
Why lie to the Holy Spirit's presence here
While it remained unsold it was your own
After it was sold the cash was yours to keep

[Chorus]
You have not lied to men but to God
Satan filled your heart with a deadly lie
The money was yours before the sale was made
Why contrive this thing in your heart so deep

[Verse]
When Ananias heard these words he fell down and died
Great fear seized all who heard the tragic tale
The young men rose and wrapped the body tight
Carrying him out to bury him in the ground

[Bridge]
About three hours later Sapphira came in
Not knowing what had befallen her husband
Peter asked the price she said it was true
But the feet of the mourners stood at the door

[Verse]
At once she fell down at his feet and died
Found dead by the young men who carried her out
They buried her beside her husband in the earth
Great fear came over the whole church of faith

[Chorus]
You have not lied to men but to God
Satan filled your heart with a deadly lie
The money was yours before the sale was made
Why contrive this thing in your heart so deep

[Outro]
Great fear came over all who heard of it
A warning for the new community of faith
